svg.title: H S Bharath Surya — intro
svg.desc: Portrait drawn as thousands of particles. A live cursor labelled Bharath sweeps across it, pushing the particles aside, then clicks a Say hello button. CS student at Newton School of Technology in Bengaluru. I design AI systems that route work across models, call tools, and keep a human approving the decisions that matter: Python, FastAPI, LLM workflows and n8n.
